column1: # Cutter reference: 200 Vietnamese sentences cut into words, for tools/cutter_test.py (`make test`, a report, not a gate).
# NOT CHECKED BY A NATIVE SPEAKER. Cut by Claude's own judgement on 17 Nov 2026, as a starting reference; a native
# speaker should correct it before its scores are trusted. Not course content.
# Sentences: the Vietnamese side of lines of the Helsinki-NLP Tatoeba Challenge eng-vie test set
# (data/test/eng-vie/test.txt at commit bd05f08; Tatoeba contributors, CC BY 2.0 FR per that repository's README, whose
# LICENSE file says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see ATTRIBUTION.md). Text unchanged except for the underscores; sentences with
# obvious typos or broken encoding were skipped.
# Format: one sentence per line, two tab-separated fields:
#   line   0-based line number in eng-vie-test.txt (tools/cutter_test.py checks the text against it when present)
#   cut    the sentence with an underscore between the syllables of one word, spaces between words (as in lessons)
# Conventions: a word is a dictionary-style lexical unit: compounds (hy_vọng, xe_buýt), lexicalised function words
# (có_thể, không_thể, bao_giờ, tất_cả, sau_khi, trước_khi, tại_sao, chúng_tôi, người_ta), names of more than one
# syllable (Nam_Mỹ, Flappy_Bird), language names with tiếng (tiếng_Anh). Kept apart: classifier + noun (cái mũ,
# con chó), pronoun + ấy/ta (anh ấy, cô ta), verb + direction or result (đi ngủ, tìm thấy, lớn lên), numerals
# (mười một), "không" before a word (không bao_giờ), phrases such as màu xanh, mọi người, nhà khoa_học.
